title: DeriveOutcomeInput
description: Full input of the outcome rules (`deriveOutcome`). The rules run once, in the core, for every engine: they decide extraction completeness, whether agents may receive the original file, and why not. `$defs/DeriveOutcome` is their output, and `$defs/OutcomeExample` is the shape of a worked example: a conversion, the input built from it, and the expected outcome.
$comment: Skipped pictures, completeness and restriction signals are carried by `units` and `warnings`: skipped pictures by `picture_format_skipped:*`, `unsupported_media_type:*` and `image_limit`; completeness by unit methods, unit characters and the readable text; restriction signals by `active_content_ignored`, `table_truncated` and `broken_text_layer`. The DC adapter applies the code aliases before it builds this input (planned). Today's DC values that the alias layer maps (unit kind `document`, unit number 0) are not representable here; no rule reads them.

error.description: Raw engine failure code, before the core's normaliser. `null` when the engine gave none.

text.description: Record text in the dialect, after adapter normalisation. `null` with a non-failed status is the step error `markdown_truncated`; empty text with a non-failed status is a final failure without text.

units.description: Units with `method`, `chars` and `warnings`. Their warnings are raw like `warnings` (`InputUnit`).

warnings.description: Result-level warnings, raw: plain strings as the engine reported them, each cut to 200 characters, not deduplicated, sorted or capped. The stored warning grammar applies only to the stored `warning_codes`; a raw entry outside it can still have an effect. Unit warnings stay on `units`; the rules read both.

images_found.description: Pictures the engine saw in the document, kept or not. The rules only test whether it is greater than 0 (`agent_file_why` gets `images`). Source: for `http` and built-in engines (planned), the sum of `units[].images`, where a unit derived from a `DocModel` counts the figure blocks of its container; on the DC JSON path, the number of DC result images, or of `](images/` links in DC's raw Markdown when that list is empty.

engine_format.description: Format of the converted file as the engine's adapter knows it, for example `pdf` or `docx`, compared without regard to case. Source: for `http` and built-in engines (planned), the `format` the core sent with the request, which is the detected format; on the DC JSON path, DC's `source_format`. It alone decides `other_format`: a `null` engine format withholds the file even for a PDF.

detected_format.description: Format the core detected at intake. It can only add `office`; it never makes a file shareable.

source_flags.description: PDF byte flags that the core reads from the original itself. Empty for a non-PDF original and for a failed result.

RawWarning.description: A raw warning entry as the engine reported it, cut to 200 characters. Not checked against the warning grammar.

InputUnit.description: A unit as the outcome rules read it: the same fields and rules as `ConversionUnit`, but its warnings are raw entries (`RawWarning`).

oneOf.description: A reviewer annotation (Text, FreeText, Popup, Highlight, Underline, StrikeOut, Squiggly, Ink, Stamp, Caret, Redact). Links and widgets do not count.
An embedded file or a file attachment.
A picture of at least 32 px on either side that is not a repeated logo (the same picture on at least 3 pages and at least 30 % of pages). When unsure, the flag is set.

OfficeFormat.description: Office formats. If the engine format or the detected format is one of them, `agent_file_why` gets `office`.

AgentFileFormat.description: The only engine formats whose file can reach agents. Any other non-office engine format, `null` included, adds `other_format`.

ExtractionState.description: Extraction completeness: how much readable text the record has. Not the run status.

ErrorClass.description: Class of an engine failure code: `terminal` (final), `rerun` (new run), `job_error` (step error).

AgentFileWhy.description: Why agents do not receive the original file. Listed in the order in which the rules add them. `broken_text_layer` is planned, not current.

DeriveOutcome.description: Output of the outcome rules. Text processing step errors (`markdown_truncated`, empty text) are failures of the step, not outcomes, and have no representation here.

status.description: Run status, passed through from the input.

text.description: Record text. Empty when the run failed.

pages.description: Number of page-anchor lines in `text`, or `null`.

agent_file.description: Whether agents may receive the original file: `true` exactly when `agent_file_why` is empty.

agent_file_why.description: Reasons in the order in which the outcome rules add them.

warning_codes.description: Result and unit warnings that match the grammar, without duplicates, sorted, at most 50. Internal: not exposed to agents.

ocr_units.description: Units whose method is in the recognition set.

ocr_rerun.description: A recognition rerun is asked for: a raw warning starts with `ocr_failed:`. The core runs at most one per cycle, outside the rerun budget; after that the result is applied as it is. `ocr_pending` alone does not cause a rerun.

error_code.description: Normalised failure code when the run failed (`conversion_failed` when the engine gave none, `unknown` for text that is not a snake_case code); otherwise `null`.

engine_format.description: Engine format, passed through from the input.

OutcomeExample.description: A worked example: the engine result, the input that the core builds from it, and the outcome that the rules MUST produce. The files under contracts/document-engine/examples/ use this shape so that tests can reuse them.

content_locale.description: Locale of the markers in the text. `en` markers are planned, not current.

rule_status.description: `current` when today's rules, with today's recognition set, give `expected` for this input as written; `planned` when `expected` depends on a planned rule or on the planned recognition set, in which case `current` gives today's outcome.
